pages.title: General Relativity
pages.text: $(thing)General Relativity$()$(br2)Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Special Relativity, Singularity Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Metric Tensor.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): The curvature of spacetime, built from the metric g_μν and its derivatives (Ricci tensor and Ricci scalar), must be sourced by the energy and momentum of matter, T_μν, with a coupling fixed so that weak fields reproduce Newtonian gravity; a constant vacuum energy may also contribute in proportion to the metric. Write the source side of the field equations.
